advisories.note: The rejecting finding is a mechanical consequence of how the speaker token is advanced between turns. Thirty-eight occurrences of 'g21-fixture-corpus.v28' correctly became 'g21-fixture-corpus.v29' in this successor, and every one of them was a self-reference where the advance is right. Exactly one occurrence was not a self-reference — the historical landing target inside findingsLandV27 — and it advanced with the rest. The structural remedy is to mark the two kinds apart in the schema rather than to sweep more carefully next turn: a findingsLand* field whose key names a version older than the immediate predecessor is by construction historical and must never carry the speaker token, while the field keyed to the immediate predecessor is by construction the only one that may. The dual-ACCEPTed g21-fixture-corpus.v25 already demonstrates the shape with four such fields coexisting correctly. Two further prose sites would benefit from the same discipline: $.findingDisposition.claudeV28M1 embeds the deleted doesNot string unquoted, so 'Landed: doesNot no longer contains Does not record leftover-join.v32 of G21 as current. Does not remasure leftover-join.v32 of G21 … remain.' reads as three sentences whose boundaries are recoverable only from prior knowledge of the finding; and $.remeasurementClause lists the speaker among the files that must be 'unmoved' before recording, which is true but self-referential and would read more cleanly as a separate freeze assertion. Neither is a rejecting defect. This is drafting guidance for the successor; the MUST-FIX above rejects on its own terms.
